newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samick says will repay debt by deadline.
newsitem.headline: Samick says will repay debt by deadline.

text.p: South Korea's Samick Musical Instrument Co Ltd said it would pay back 2.7 billion won in primissory notes by the legal deadline of Wednesday, a company spokesman said.
"We have no problem in paying back the debt by the end of today," the spokesman said by telephone.

An official at Dongnam Bank, a creditor, said Samick failed to pay back the sum by the due date of Tuesday and would be declared defaulting on the debt if it could not settle the promissory notes by the close of business on Wednesday.
